summary: Ran live API regression plus browser booking, confirmation, management, and mobile checks. Core UI and API flows passed, with one cross-session persistence integration gap identified.

integration_issues.flow: Management appointment listing after a fresh session
integration_issues.issue: AdminPanel renders appointments only from localStorage and never GETs /api/appointments, so Mongo-persisted bookings are not listed when localStorage is empty or on another browser/device.

action_items: Load appointments from GET /api/appointments when opening management and reconcile with local state; retain local fallback only when API is unavailable.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend booking POST is fire-and-forget and AdminPanel has no API read path, creating inconsistent cross-session/device state despite backend persistence.
test_credentials: Not applicable; no auth flow tested.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST_ appointment through the API regression test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API root, appointment CRUD, duplicate conflict, booking modal steps, confirmation, service add, and 390px no-overflow passed. Re-test management after implementing API appointment loading and verify same booking appears in a new browser context.
rca of the issue: App.js initializes appointments exclusively from localStorage (line 24) and AdminPanel receives that state; there is no fetch GET /api/appointments. POST persistence is therefore not reflected in a fresh session or another device.
